prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished 16:9 widescreen main-menu background for original science-fiction RTS AsteraCraft, no UI or text.
Primary request: redesign the citrus faction's home planet landscape to match its current living citrus-tree root and orange tangerine-juice concept.
Scene: an epic alien citrus world seen from its surface. In the right two thirds, an enormous ancient citrus mother-tree colony rises from a terraced valley, its rugged dark-brown wooden roots spreading over the ground, intertwining with organically grown orange-peel brood pods and bark-covered colony structures. Thick translucent amber-orange citrus sap flows in narrow streams and small pools among roots, catching warm light; it looks like juice/resin, not fiery lava. Real citrus leaves and small clusters of tangerines make the biology unmistakable. Foreground roots have convincing woody grain, wet orange sap and dark soil. A vast curved orange-and-earth-colored celestial world hangs in the distant hazy sky, with subtle branching surface patterns, creating a planetary science-fiction scale.
Composition: wide cinematic 16:9 landscape. Strong readable focal point on the RIGHT around 65-75% width. The LEFT 30% must be comparatively quiet, darker atmospheric terrain and sky for an existing vertical menu and logo; do not render the menu. A vista with depth, foreground/middle/background layers, naturally organized forms, no visual clutter. All important forms remain inside safe margins.
Style: highly polished painterly realistic RTS key art, carefully resolved materials, crisp silhouettes, cohesive atmospheric perspective, premium game splash-screen quality.
Palette: earthy brown wood and soil, deep green leaves, warm tangerine orange, honey amber sap, muted olive distant haze. Balanced warm lighting, restrained glow.
Avoid: purple infestation/slime, fleshy horror, mechanical orange metal domes, prominent cyan lights, lava/fire rivers, repeated identical props, giant literal orange fruit as the entire planet, cartoon faces, writing, typography, logos, borders, watermark.
Output one complete original background image, no collage, opaque background.
